title: Saxophia gen2
description: Our classic saxophone instrument is back under new version due to your continual requests. We also added 2 new models (jazz, pop), added poping up advanced edtior and added a cool "spread" effect which emulates 3 voices unison. Saxophia gen2's goals are easy to use yet good sounding plug & play style saxophone, cheap in resources and quickly editable with full midi learn capabilities (right mouse click on any significant button or knob).
